summary: Updates no longer get stuck behind a long wait or a stuck job.

fixes.title: Updates no longer fail after waiting
fixes.text: An update that waited for a running job now fetches the release again before it downloads, so a long wait no longer stops it until the next night.

fixes.title: A stuck job no longer blocks updates
fixes.text: A job stuck for hours is now stopped and reported instead of holding the update back. A stuck tamper check no longer holds back the next checks.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Every job shows a first line in its log when it starts, the hybrid worker's database access is added without waiting for jobs, and Pro MCP tool names follow the standard form.
